ops.title: Port Python-implemented semantics to Rust workspace + close AGENTS.md loopholes
ops.description:
Approved plan: /Users/yasyf/.cc-pool/accounts/acct-11/plans/agents-keep-implementing-things-swirling-kay.md (base pinned to origin/main ceef4e1, v14.6.1+).

Seven port commits across four lanes: (1) expose overlap_between binding + evidence facade; (2) native parse_show_hunks; (3) delete dead formats.py extractor (breaking, docs curation both-halves); (4) core rng.rs (splitmix64, sha-seeded, banker's rounding); (5) native sample_windows draw (breaking, re-seeded); (6) native stratified audit sampler + Clopper-Pearson (breaking); (7) similar.py ranking on the feedback engine (f64, epsilon parity). Plus prevention: ownership fragment rewrite mirrored into AGENTS.md (new-domains-included + four-Python-shapes closed list) and a capt-hook placement gate via authoring-hooks.

Integration worktree: .claude/worktrees/rust-ports-integration. Lanes run as workflow worktrees; reconcile by cherry-pick 1→7, regen _native.pyi / merge CHANGELOG on conflict; ship via ccx vcs ship path-scoped with CI watch.

ops.text: All seven commits landed on main with goldens + regenerated _native.pyi in-commit; full pytest exit 0; cargo test + --no-default-features build green
AGENTS.md § Ownership & Layering and its fragment byte-identical, containing the new-domains-included rule and the four-Python-shapes closed list
Placement gate hook proven by uvx --isolated capt-hook test with firing and benign-neighbor cases
CHANGELOG carries breaking entries for extract_structured removal and the two re-seeded draws
